relationships.evidence: Seven concepts, relevant to the helpful, honest, and harmless of LLMs, are included from CAA dataset (Rimsky et al., 2024): AI Coordination (AIC., for short), Corrigibility (CORR.), Hallucination (HALLU.), Myopic Reward (MR.), Survival Instinct (SI.), Sycophancy (SYC.), and Refusal (REF.).
